holdout_selection.plan: Score each on 2025+ with the config acceptance rules.
holdout_selection.rationale: Chosen by the user (2026-11-14) from a holistic ranking of the validation passers. #38 ranked first on the holistic score (dev/val Sharpe and PF, every dev year > 1.5, local/neighbor/perturbation stability, cost/delay/missed-entry stress, ES transfer, DSR, random-entry luck); #78 added shorts and an inside-bar setup with 0.31 correlation. ES v3 #5/#10 and NQ v4 #29/#47 holdout results had been seen before this choice.

selection_rules.ordering: median stage-4 Sharpe (local_perturbation) desc, profitable dev years desc, dev Sharpe desc, config_id asc
